title: Abhidhammattha-saṅgaha Library
tagline: Ācariya Anuruddha’s manual of the Abhidhamma — its Pāli text, its commentaries and its translations — one chapter per page, with the Saṅgaha’s own paragraphs as a common map between the books.

books.drawer_hint: These texts have no index of their own.
books.title: Abhidhammatthasaṅgaho
books.author: Ācariya Anuruddha
books.edition: Sixth Council edition, VRI digital text
books.by: Ācariya Anuruddha · the Sixth Council (Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana) text, Yangon · digital edition of the Vipassana Research Institute
books.blurb: The manual itself: the four ultimate realities in nine chapters, from consciousness to meditation, in verse and prose.
books.note: The whole text, one chapter per page: the opening verses, the nine paricchedas and the closing verses. Each paragraph carries the Saṅgaha’s own number (I.1, I.2 … IX.75), the map that every book of this library follows; a small chip beside it opens the same paragraph in the Vibhāvinī. The pages of the Myanmar edition are marked in the margin.
books.toc_foot: The nine chapters ({{NPARA}} numbered paragraphs), in the Sixth Council text.
books.source: Source: the Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana (Sixth Council) text as published in digital form by the Vipassana Research Institute (github.com/VipassanaTech/tipitaka-xml), file romn/abh07t.nrf.xml, first book. The text is unchanged; the paragraph numbers and the Myanmar edition’s page numbers are as in the file. In Chapter IV the file numbers its paragraphs 1, 2, 4 (there is no 3); the numbers are kept as they are.
books.desc: The Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha in the Pāli of the Sixth Council edition, with its paragraph numbers, linked to its commentaries and translations.
howto: Type in Search (or press /). Accents are optional: rupa finds rūpa.
Type chapter and paragraph in §, e.g. 4.6 for IV.6.
The chip beside a paragraph opens the same paragraph in the Vibhāvinī.

books.title: Abhidhammatthavibhāvinīṭīkā
books.author: Ācariya Sumaṅgala
books.edition: Sixth Council edition, VRI digital text
books.by: Ācariya Sumaṅgala (12th century) · the Sixth Council text · digital edition of the Vipassana Research Institute
books.blurb: The classic commentary on the Saṅgaha, read in Myanmar beside the root text; explains it phrase by phrase.
books.note: The whole commentary, one chapter per page. VRI numbers it by the paragraph of the Saṅgaha it explains, so each numbered paragraph carries that Saṅgaha number (I.11 …) and a chip back to it. The words of the Saṅgaha being explained are in bold, as in the edition.
books.toc_foot: The commentary on the nine chapters ({{NPARA}} numbered paragraphs).
books.source: Source: the Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana (Sixth Council) text as published in digital form by the Vipassana Research Institute (github.com/VipassanaTech/tipitaka-xml), file romn/abh07t.nrf.xml, second book (Abhidhammatthavibhāvinīṭīkā). The text is unchanged; the closing verses (Nigamanakathā) keep their own numbers 1–7 in the text.
books.desc: The Abhidhammatthavibhāvinī-ṭīkā in Pāli, paragraph by paragraph against the Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha.
howto: Type in Search (or press /). Accents are optional: rupa finds rūpa.
Type chapter and paragraph of the Saṅgaha in §, e.g. 1.11.
The chip beside a paragraph opens the paragraph of the Saṅgaha it explains.

books.title: Paramatthadīpanī
books.author: Ledi Sayadaw
books.edition: Sixth Council edition, VRI digital text
books.by: Ledi Sayadaw (1846–1923) · Saṅgaha-mahāṭīkā · digital edition of the Vipassana Research Institute
books.blurb: Ledi Sayadaw’s great commentary on the Saṅgaha, which weighs the Vibhāvinī and often disagrees with it.
books.note: The whole text, one chapter of the Saṅgaha per page, with its own paragraph numbers (1–174) running through the book; a chip beside each opens the same paragraph in the Anudīpanī, Ledi Sayadaw’s own commentary on it.
books.source: Source: the Chaṭṭha Saṅgāyana (Sixth Council) text as published in digital form by the Vipassana Research Institute (github.com/VipassanaTech/tipitaka-xml), file romn/e0301n.nrf.xml. The text is unchanged. Where the file repeats a paragraph number (66, 67) or prints one out of order (31), the number is left in the text as printed and not made an anchor.
books.desc: Ledi Sayadaw’s Paramatthadīpanī on the Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha, in Pāli.
